6aa16ee2ad.q: What is Comfort Capital's approach to depreciation benefits in mobile home park acquisitions?
6aa16ee2ad.a: Comfort Capital prioritizes acquiring mobile home parks in markets with lower land values to maximize depreciation benefits. With 100% bonus depreciation, the difference between properties with high land costs versus low land costs can result in year-one losses of 120% versus 70%. Blake Comfort notes that buying in expensive land markets like California hamstrings the depreciation advantage that makes mobile home park investing attractive compared to multifamily, which relies on cash flow and depreciation as the primary return drivers.
